# Which students should I book, and when, to earn the most from my teaching week?

> Free lesson scheduler for private tutors, music teachers and coaches: enter each student's fee and the times they can come, and get the weekly timetable that earns the most, with gaps, room costs and must-keep students. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
